open_points.subject: A09 rule 2 / A10 rule 7 multipart value parts
open_points.text: "a multipart/form-data body with one part per other input port ... a value part carrying its canonical JSON" and "the request ... for multipart/form-data [is] the parts in order, each as its name, media type and the SHA-256 of its content"
open_points.question: What media type must be set (or considered) for non-file multipart parts, so request construction and request_digest are deterministic?
options: Set each value part Content-Type to application/json
Set no Content-Type for value parts and treat media type as absent in request_digest
Set a fixed custom media type for all value parts
open_points.default_guess: Set value parts to application/json and include that in request_digest.

open_points.subject: A10 rule 7 request_digest headers
open_points.text: "the request an approval covers is described ... [by] every header the kernel sends"
open_points.question: Does "every header the kernel sends" include transport/client-added headers (for example Host, Content-Length, multipart boundary headers), or only headers explicitly set by kernel rules?
options: Include only headers explicitly set by kernel logic (required headers + credential header + explicit protocol headers)
Include all headers present on the wire, including client/library-added ones
open_points.default_guess: Include only headers explicitly constructed by kernel rules; ignore library-added wire headers.

open_points.subject: A09 rule 3 handling 2xx body when binding has zero outputs
open_points.text: "otherwise the body must be UTF-8 text that parses as one JSON object ..." and later "a binding without output ports ignores the body"
open_points.question: For a non-file binding with no output ports, must a 2xx response body still parse as a JSON object, or is any body accepted/ignored?
options: Still require valid UTF-8 JSON object even with zero outputs
Skip body parsing entirely when output port set is empty
open_points.default_guess: Skip parsing when there are zero outputs and ignore the body.

open_points.subject: A13 rule 5 upstream_failed with guarded edges
open_points.text: "A node an input of which comes from a failed node ... concludes upstream_failed ... when both rule 4 and this rule apply, this rule wins."
open_points.question: When an input has guarded incoming edges, should a failed source count for upstream_failed if that edge is currently disabled by guard?
options: Only consider currently enabled edges when determining upstream_failed
Consider any incoming edge regardless of guard state
open_points.default_guess: Consider only enabled edges; a disabled edge should not force upstream_failed.
